units.source_text: 源氏公子回到二条院，就准备行装。

en.t: Prince Genji returned to the Nijo residence and began preparing for his journey.

units.source_text: 他召集一向亲近而不附权势的一切忠仆，吩咐他们分别管理今后邸内上下一切事务。

en.t: He gathered all the loyal servants who had always been close to him and had not attached themselves to power, and instructed them to divide up the management of all affairs throughout the residence from then on.

units.source_text: 又从其中选出数人，带赴须磨。

en.t: He also chose several of them to take with him to Suma.

units.source_text: 客中所用物件，仅选日常必需之品，并且不加装潢，力求朴素。

en.t: For the things he would use while away from home, he selected only everyday necessities, left them undecorated, and made every effort to keep them plain.

units.source_text: 又带些必要的汉文书籍。

en.t: He also took along some necessary Chinese books.

units.source_text: 装白居易文集等的书箱和一张琴，也都带去。

en.t: He also brought a book chest containing works such as the collected writings of Bai Juyi, as well as a koto.

units.source_text: 其余铺张的用具和华美的服装，一概不带。

en.t: All other extravagant furnishings and splendid clothing were left behind.

units.source_text: 竟把自己装成一个山野平民模样。

en.t: In the end, he made himself look like a commoner from the countryside.
